title: It Works but Description is Misleading
text:
It Works but Description is Misleading. Storage containers are a necessity for any household. We have lots of excess stuff and we need places to put it and keep it out of harm’s way. This need led me to get the DII Home Essentials Large Plate Storage Bin, a storage container recommended for dishes, photos, etc.

We are getting ready to move to a new home and because of this, we have found the need to store as much of our household contents as possible to clear the house of clutter and prepare to change residences. This was enough to convince me to obtain this storage bin. We have lots of dishes and it seemed like something that would come in very handy.

What I quickly learned when I opened the package and examined the DII Home Essentials Large Plate Storage Bin is that this container is not really meant to protect fragile dishes, like I was led to believe. Looking at other reviews, I can see that I am not the only one with this concern. The container is too flimsy to use for my glass plates and anything else that could break. It’s fine for plastic ware and that is exactly what I am using mine for. But it is not good for anything breakable and I’m a little disappointed at the manufacturer for making this misleading claim.

If you can get past the deception, you will find that this is a decent storage bin, even if it is a little on the small side. It’s only fourteen inches square and just four inches deep so it is very limited in what it can handle. I find it sufficient for my plastic plates plus other small plastic items. It won’t do for much else, but what can you expect for something this size?

Storage containers are important and they especially matter to someone in the early stages of relocation. This storage bin is acceptable, but I’m still a little annoyed that the manufacturer led me to believe it would be good for storing china and other breakables. It might work for items like that if you’re placing the storage container in one place and not moving it. But if you plan to transport anything, play it safe and use this container for plastic, clothing, or other unbreakable items. It really can’t handle much else so keep this in mind if you buy.
